# Cindy Wanady

> Cindy Wanady works in data and practices yoga. She has six years across CRM automation, data migration and operational reporting, four of them at Mekari. She completed a Master of Data Science at Monash University with Distinction. She has practiced Hatha and Vinyasa yoga for three years, completed a 100-hour yoga teacher training at Vidyarasa, and has a 200-hour training in progress.

## Data

- [Data work](https://cindywanady.github.io/data/): current work at Mekari, earlier roles at PwC Indonesia and JET Express, course projects, and skills.
- [Master's thesis](https://cindywanady.github.io/data/thesis/): a retrieval-augmented chatbot grounded in Indonesia's Ministry of Health depression guideline, rated blind by licensed psychologists.

## Yoga

- [Yoga practice](https://cindywanady.github.io/yoga/): trainings, styles, and a sequence she practices.

## About and contact

- [About](https://cindywanady.github.io/about/): education at Monash, Prasetiya Mulya and Tsinghua, and languages.
- [Contact](https://cindywanady.github.io/contact/): LinkedIn, Instagram and GitHub. No email address is published.
